newsitem.title: LEBANON: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.
newsitem.headline: Shares mixed on Beirut Stock Exchange.

text.p: Shares were mixed on the Beirut Stock Exchange on Monday as three shares rose and three shares held steady out of nine stocks of seven listed companies.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce rose to $14.25 from Friday's $14 while Banque Audi held steady at $19.125.
Solidere A shares were unchanged at $10.25 and B shares at $10.75. Total turnover in the company's shares was 99,393 shares from 88,038 on Friday.
The LIBX bank index rose 0.89 percent to 121.17 while the BLOM stock index rose 0.34 percent to 905.93 and the LISPI rose 0.59 percent to 85.55.
A total of 22,850 shares of industrial pipemaker Eternit changed hands at $2.0312 up from $2.0 on Thursday when they were last traded.
Ciments Libanais rose to $1.21875 from Friday's $1.1875 on turnover of 9,445 shares from 100.
There was no trade in the two other listed firms: Ciments Blancs and Uniceramic.
Total BSE turnover was 142,603 shares for a value of $1,291,833 against 103,859 for a value of $1,188,365 on Friday.
